title: Where Do Images Come From? Analyzing Captions to Geographically Profile Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Geolocalizing image-caption pairs from large-scale multimodal datasets using LLMs and an entity-presence classifier, comparing empirical country-level distributions to real-world statistics, and evaluating the diversity and coverage of country-specific generated images using precision and recall metrics.

Calculating the correlation between a country's frequency of representation in vision-language datasets and country-level socio-economic indicators such as nominal GDP, GDP per capita, and the number of internet users.

Comparing the geographical distribution of image-caption pairs across multiple language subsets (English, Spanish, Hindi, Greek, Japanese) to demonstrate how representation heavily skews toward countries where the dataset language is predominantly spoken.
